name: Onnasamurai Kaede
source: In the village where the traveling female samurai Kaede stopped by, a village girl had been kidnapped by bandits! In order to save the girl, Kaede decides to head alone to the bandits' hideout...
translation: In the village where the traveling female samurai Kaede stopped by, a village girl had been kidnapped by bandits! In order to save the girl, Kaede decides to head alone to the bandits' hideout...
